written: 2026-10-22 01:16:24 EDT. Written before any whole grid has been run (pieces are in progress; no whole-grid inference has started).
reason: Measured cost 1.13 ms per bus-scenario-pass on the loaded box (76 pilot/main passes). Pieces project to ~4.4 worker-hours (done about 03:10 EDT). Whole grids project to ~20.5 worker-hours, the seen set alone ~10.4, so running seen_whole to completion in ascending order would leave unseen_whole entirely unrun. The caller's rule already allows skipping whole grids above ~3,000 buses.
amendment: Whole-grid sets are run in TWO passes. Pass 1 (cap): grids with <= 3,100 buses only, seen_whole first (ascending) then unseen_whole (ascending). Expected: seen 500, 793, 2000, 2312, 2742, 3022 (6 of 15); unseen 6 SimBench-HV, 1888, 2848, 2869, 2383, 3012 (11 of 17). Pass 2 (only if time remains before the 07:30 EDT deadline): the larger grids, ascending in bus count, seen_whole first and then unseen_whole, each started only if its projection finishes before the deadline. Everything not run is listed as skipped with the reason 'size above cap / time'. All other protocol rules, the threshold and the inconclusive rule are unchanged; the inconclusive rule (fewer than half the grids run) will apply to the whole-grid pool and to each whole-grid set separately.
effect_on_reading: A threshold result on whole grids refers to the small and medium grids that ran, not the 4,000-9,600-bus ones; the report must say so.
